map_001.name: Vô Danh Thôn
map_001.landmark: a humble rural hamlet with straw roofs beside a winding stream, bamboo groves, small vegetable plots and a worn wooden footbridge; human scale, no magic monuments

map_002.name: Thanh Ngưu Trấn
map_002.landmark: a modest market town, grey tiled roofs along a curved river, one small stone arch bridge and an ox-shaped carved gate stone, nearby green paddocks

map_003.name: Thất Huyền Môn
map_003.landmark: a martial sect mountain gate, seven distinct slender mountain ridges, stepped path winding up to austere timber halls; pine trees, restrained buildings, no huge celestial palace

map_004.name: Hắc Phong Sơn
map_004.landmark: a dark wind-beaten mountain gorge, black rocky crags, twisted pines, weathered rope bridge and a rough bandit palisade on a cliff; an open path through the gorge

map_005.name: Thái Nam Cốc
map_005.landmark: a hidden jade valley with natural river loops, terraced meadows, a small cultivator market of cloth awnings and bamboo cottages, flowering medicinal herbs, surrounding rounded mountains

map_006.name: Hoàng Phong Cốc
map_006.landmark: an expansive golden valley, amber cliffs, wind-swept autumn pines, an elegant but modest cultivation sect hall nested between cliffs and a curving stone stair; stage2 more refined than villages

map_007.name: Huyết Sắc Cấm Địa
map_007.landmark: a sealed ancient red forest sanctuary, crimson foliage, broken stone gate with a faint crimson seal, dark jade marsh and winding path between ancient roots; no gore

map_008.name: Yểm Nguyệt Tông
map_008.landmark: a secluded moon sect on a curving mountain lake, white tiled pavilions and slender arched walkways, crescent moon reflection, flowering pale trees and low drifting mist; restrained magic

map_009.name: Vạn Khôi Sơn
map_009.landmark: a rugged mountain workshop sect, stepped stone terraces, small carved wooden and bronze training puppets beside the path, carved stone halls, ore carts and a waterwheel; no modern machinery

map_010.name: Việt Kinh Thành
map_010.landmark: an impressive human imperial capital with ancient city walls, broad curved canal, layered traditional red-gold palace roofs in the distance, patterned market districts and a large stone gate; grand mortal scale, not celestial
